payload.claim: `blocker_answers`'s docstring says `turn.error is not None` is 'the same test `rebut_state` already makes', but `rebut_state` (same file, lines 526-588) never tests `error is not None`; it only does a truthiness check `rebuttal.error or "recorded nothing"` on line 543, which treats an empty-string error as falsy. The actual precedent for the `is not None` test is `saffron/report/pr_body.py`'s `_rebuttal_errored` (lines 250-252), not `rebut_state`. The citation points a reader to the wrong function.
